findings.title: Unvectorized Lambda Datetime Conversion in Generator
findings.impact: Slow iteration speed during large-scale tabular synthesis.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace Python lambda map with vectorized integer division timestamp conversion.

falsification.note: Vectorized timestamp conversion implemented and verified.

findings.title: Floating-point Underflow/Overflow in Exponential Mechanism
findings.impact: Unbounded utility scores could cause exp() to overflow to inf or underflow to 0, corrupting DP probability distributions.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement log-sum-exp numerical stabilization by subtracting max score before exponentiation.

falsification.note: Log-sum-exp normalization implemented and verified with extreme value tests.
